text: {"frames":["Somehow the books on the third floor of the Tower had swapped their shelves in the night, and the reading lamp hummed a tune nobody knew. The librarian, a tall thin man with ink on his cuffs, pointed at two piles on the table: {a} books stood on the left and {b} on the right. Compare the numbers {a} and {b}. Which sign goes between them?","You knock on the green door of the bakery, and a grey pigeon drops a letter at your feet. The baker reads it, laughs, and says it was meant for the tailor upstairs, where {a} spools of thread wait on the shelf beside {b} loaves of bread that the baker has just sent up. Compare the numbers {a} and {b}. Which sign goes between them?","The velvet seats from the travelling theatre have gone missing, and the actors are hunting for them under the stairs. Only the benches in the gardens are left, and the gardener is standing in the aisle with his rake. Row one has {a} seats, and row two has {b} seats. Compare the numbers {a} and {b}. Which sign goes between them?","A smell of hot oil drifts down the stairs of the toy workshop, and a click-click sound comes from under the bench. A small wind-up mouse has come alive and is pulling a box of buttons across the floor. The box holds {a} red buttons, and the tin beside it holds {b} blue ones. Compare the numbers {a} and {b}. Which sign goes between them?","The fisher leans over the rail on the lowest floor and calls to you for help with his nets. The threads have knotted them all night, and he cannot see where the ends begin. On the net hang {a} floats, and on the rope lie {b} hooks. Compare the numbers {a} and {b}. Which sign goes between them?"]}
